connector.name: Ferric Fred MCP
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for FRED (Federal Reserve Economic Data): full read API plus GeoFRED, 34 tools.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Cargo crate ferric-fred-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the ojhermann-org account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: FRED_API_KEY
env.description: FRED API key (free from the St. Louis Fed: https://fredaccount.stlouisfed.org/apikeys). Required for the server to start.
